reasons: Worth a cheap measurement, and this is the leg where it can be measured. Per-trade sigma is about 1.07 R (gotobi_tweaks current rule: +0.144 R, t 3.16 on 561 design trades). The VIX state is close to orthogonal to the approved ATR state in design (correlation 0.09 between the two trailing-year percentiles on gotobi days, 0.31 in check), so the increment is identified and is not a relabelled ATR filter. In gj-strat, VIX appears only in the carry, index vol-timing, index mean-reversion and COT tests, never on the box or the gotobi, and no earlier hypothesis in this programme used the vol series.

As written, the cells cannot meet the pre-registration. Design gotobi days 2011-2017 (counts only, data cut 2024-01-01): all 502, atr 219, vix_hi50 184, vix_hi70 109, atr_vix50 83, atr_vix70 57. Both atr_vix cells are below the 90-trade minimum, so the intersection can never be adopted. The 70 threshold halves the VIX-high strata without a theoretical reason; the approved ATR filter is a median rule.

The kill rule does not account for speed. The stated success case (0.2 R on 1.5 trades a month, a score of 0.245) is slower than the approved vol-gotobi it would replace (0.17 R x sqrt(2.6) = 0.27). It is also slower than the unfiltered gotobi in design (0.144 R x sqrt(5.8) = 0.35). In costs_gotobi, the ATR filter itself cut the Alpha Swing pass-within-2-months rate from 25.4% to 19.8%, while cutting the 6-month fail rate from 43.6% to 30.9%. An intersection keeping 83 of 219 trades needs 1.62x the 'atr' arm's avg R just to hold the speed, far more than +0.05 R. Under the 60-day goal, the only gate that can raise this leg's speed is the union: trade when ATR is high OR VIX is high (320 design trades, 3.8 a month). The union helps only if the VIX-high days it adds beat the ATR-low days it leaves out. Separately, the first kill clause compares vix_hi with 'all', while the rationale says VIX must beat the ATR filter.

Confound. VIX-high states follow US equity selloffs, and the scrap index records that yen crosses bounce in the Tokyo morning after a US selloff (jpy_cross_losscut_after_us_shock). Any VIX-conditioned shift in the 00:55-06:00 UTC USDJPY drift would show up in a gotobi short whether or not it has anything to do with the fix, and none of the arms controls for this. A non-gotobi placebo fixes that: the same short on non-gotobi weekdays (1312 design days; the SE of its VIX split is about 0.06 R) separates a fix-specific increment from a VIX-state drift.

Mechanism. The rationale says implied vol prices the USDJPY risk that fix dealers carry, ahead of realised ATR. In design, VIX does not track USDJPY risk: in 2012, 2013 and 2016, ATR was high on 43-75% of gotobi days while VIX was above its trailing median on only 15-35% of them, and 2011 and 2014 were the reverse (ATR high on 24-26%, VIX high on 49-53%). The testable claim is narrower: global risk appetite changes the size of the front-run inventory that dealers unwind after the fix. The prior for that is modest, so treat this as a measurement, not a likely edge.

Power, and what a null means. The stratified VIX effect (VIX-high minus VIX-low inside the ATR-high and ATR-low strata, trade-weighted) has a design SE of about 0.10 R (about 0.105 R in check). VIX-high days come in about 90 episodes in design, so trades within an episode are not independent. A null therefore rules out only effects above about 0.2 R. It does not close the question 'at the 0.1 R level' as the rationale says. The direction note's claim that 'a null closes the vol-state question for the parked legs at the 0.05-0.10 R level' is wrong for both legs. The stop-the-loop recommendation should rest on the speed arithmetic (a VIX state on these legs adds at most a few hundredths to the basket's monthly Sharpe of 0.4), not on these nulls.

Pipeline. With 'all' in the stage A grid (design t about 3), a reference arm passes the GA floor whatever the VIX cells do. Stage C's absolute gates (check > 0, walk-forward > 0, 1.5x costs) pass for any gotobi subset. The increment therefore has to be gated explicitly, in design and in check. Note also that the trailing-year percentile is relative: after the very calm 2017, 88% of 2018 gotobi days are 'VIX-high', so the check-period VIX-high stratum leans on 2018, 2020 and 2022; read the check confirmation together with the by-year table.
revisions: R1 Common sample: every arm, 'all' included, trades only gotobi weekdays from 2011-01-01 on which both the oracle's ATR median and the VIX percentile are defined. All cells then sit inside one day set, and because a gotobi trade never runs into the next day, the strata partition 'all' exactly. R2 One threshold, chosen from theory: vix_pct = 50 only (VIX at or above its trailing 250-close median, the same construction as the approved ATR median rule). V+ = pct >= 50 and V- = pct < 50, a strict complement. Drop the 70 cells and the 'pct <= 100 - vix_pct' arm. R3 Hypothesis cell: the spec grid, and the only cell stages B and C validate, is {state: ['atr_or_vix'], vix_pct: [50]}, i.e. ATR-high or VIX-high (320 design trades, 3.8 a month). It is the only gate that can raise the leg's speed. Minimum: 300 design trades. R4 Stage A grid of 9 cells, all at vix_pct 50, recorded as trials. Gotobi days: 'atr_vix' (ATR-high and VIX-high, 83 design), 'atr_vixlo' (ATR-high, VIX-low, 136), 'natr_vix' (ATR-low, VIX-high, 101), 'natr_vixlo' (ATR-low, VIX-low, 182), 'all' (about 504), 'atr' (219) and 'atr_or_vix' (320). Placebo on non-gotobi weekdays, running the identical short, stop and exit: 'ng_vix' (VIX-high, 495) and 'ng_vixlo' (VIX-low, 817). The reference and placebo arms are never promoted. R5 Kill rule. Every clause must hold, read from the stage A cells, and the GA floor and the kill rule are applied to 'atr_or_vix' and the strata, never to 'all' or 'atr'. K1: the stratified VIX effect E = w_A x (R[atr_vix] - R[atr_vixlo]) + w_N x (R[natr_vix] - R[natr_vixlo]), with each weight equal to that stratum's share of the common sample, is at least +0.10 R in design (about 1 SE, the increment analogue of the stage A floor), and both within-stratum differences are above 0. K2: the union's design t exceeds the 'atr' arm's design t (same period, so the union is faster), and R[natr_vix] exceeds R[natr_vixlo]; without the second part the union could look faster only because ATR-low gotobi days happened to be positive in design. K3: the gotobi VIX effect over all gotobi days (trade-weighted from the strata) exceeds the placebo's (R[ng_vix] - R[ng_vixlo]) by at least +0.05 R. If the placebo effect is as large, the result is a VIX-conditioned Tokyo-morning drift: nothing is registered as a gotobi refinement, and its sign may not be used to register a standalone VIX short (that would be a snooped flip, and the US-shock-to-Tokyo family is dead). K4: before anything is adopted, using the same cells' check rows, E is above 0 in check 2018-2023 and the union's check t is at least the 'atr' arm's check t. This clause is needed because the stage C gates cannot fail a gotobi subset. K5: report E gross of costs as well as net, and with month-clustered SEs. R6 Restate the expectations: union about 3.8 trades a month; expected E between 0 and +0.10 R; union score 0.27-0.33 if E > 0. Record a null as 'no VIX effect larger than about 0.2 R on the gotobi', not as 'implied vol closed'. R7 Restate the mechanism as risk appetite and front-run inventory, not as a forward-looking gauge of USDJPY risk, and keep the clause that a VIX-low result is never registered as a low-vol hypothesis.
notes_for_builder: Base trade: copy strategies/oracle/gotobi_short.py. Dates come from F.utc_dates, weekdays only, from p['start']. The entry bar ei = F.first_bar_at_or_after(m, dates, 0, 55) must fall within p['max_delay_min'] minutes. Set entry_short on ei - 1 and exit_short on xi - 1, where xi is the first bar at or after 06:00 UTC. sl_dist = p['sl_atr'] x ATR20 at ei. Keep the oracle's guards (ei < 1, xi >= m.n, xi <= ei, ATR not finite or not positive). Day sets: gotobi = F.is_gotobi(dates) for every state except 'ng_vix' and 'ng_vixlo', which use the non-gotobi weekdays (~F.is_gotobi(dates)). ATR state: use the oracle's loop verbatim (for i >= w - 1, med[i] = np.nanmedian(atr_d[i - w + 1:i + 1]) with w = p['atr_window'], and hot = atr_d >= med); the state is undefined where med is NaN. VIX state: build e = F.ext_series(m, 'vol') and sub = F.ext_subset(m, 'vol', np.isfinite(e.column('vix'))). Do not use F.ext_asof on the full table: its US-holiday rows have a ts_avail but a null vix, which would make the next Tokyo morning undefined. Return the empty Signals if sub.n == 0 (truncated leak-test samples). Compute pct[j] = 100 x mean(x[lo:j + 1] <= x[j]) with lo = max(0, j - p['vix_window'] + 1), and NaN if j + 1 - lo < p['vix_min_obs']. A Python loop over about 4,000 rows is fine; never use a full-sample or centred statistic, because the perturbation test catches it. Map pct to bars with k = np.searchsorted(sub.ts_avail, m.close_times(), side='right') - 1 (the F.ext_asof rule), NaN where k < 0, and read it at the signal bar ei - 1. V+ = pct >= p['vix_pct'] - 1e-9 and V- = pct < p['vix_pct'] - 1e-9; ATR-high = hot, ATR-low = not hot. Common sample: in every arm, 'all' included, skip the day unless both states are defined. Arms for p['state']: 'all', 'atr' (ATR-high), 'atr_vix' (ATR-high and V+), 'atr_vixlo' (ATR-high and V-), 'natr_vix' (ATR-low and V+), 'natr_vixlo' (ATR-low and V-), 'atr_or_vix' (ATR-high or V+), 'ng_vix' (non-gotobi, V+), 'ng_vixlo' (non-gotobi, V-). Raise on an unknown state. PARAMS must hold every grid key with defaults state 'atr_or_vix' and vix_pct 50, plus entry_utc, exit_utc, sl_atr, max_delay_min, vix_window 250, vix_min_obs 120, atr_n 20, atr_window 250 and start '2011-01-01'. Expected design counts (2011-2017, within a few days): all about 504, atr 219, atr_vix 83, atr_vixlo 136, natr_vix 101, natr_vixlo 182, atr_or_vix 320, ng_vix about 495, ng_vixlo about 817. A count far from these means the day set or a state is wrong.
